From the vector addition and scalar multiplication rules, we have

$$
{\int }_{0}^{3}[2f(t)+4g(t)]\,\text{d}t=2{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+4{\int }_{0}^{3}g(t)\,\text{d}t.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{3}[2f(t)+4g(t)]\,\text{d}t & =2{\int }_{0}^{3}f(t)\,\text{d}t+4{\int }_{0}^{3}g(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =2⟨-3,\,\sqrt{2},\,2⟩+4⟨-\frac{3}{2},\,-\frac{1}{4},\,1⟩ \\  & =⟨-6,\,2\sqrt{2},\,4⟩+⟨-6,\,-1,\,4⟩ \\  & =⟨-12,\,2\sqrt{2}-1,\,8⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
